title: GCP-6.5: response-code semantics divergent (Rust 2.05 not 4.09+winning claim, no 4.03; C missing +5s tolerance; vectors pin 2.01/4.29)
description: Spec GCP-6.5 response codes: (a) success should be 2.04 Changed (Rust sends 2.05, C sends 2.01); (b) conflict should be 4.09 Conflict with the winning gateway's claim in the body (Rust sends empty 4.09, C sends NULL); (c) unauthorized should be 4.03 (no impl sends 4.03 for failed sig, they use 4.01); (d) C missing +5s clock tolerance on expiry check. Fix response codes to match spec + vectors.
